digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md documentation for close precheck
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when it actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status
The close precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and the completion-verification gate being enabled, but is presented as unconditional in both docs
AGENTS.md omits documentation of 'rebar transition <id> in_progress closed --ref <sha>' as the sanctioned way to close a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree

The _referencing_commit_exists function scans git history with no ref argument and accepts commits referencing the ticket or any transitive descendant, not just the ticket itself, but docs do not explain the descendant subtree behavior
--ref retargets only the completion verification and signature to that ref's tree; it does not narrow the referencing-commit scan, and this distinction is missing from both docs
The land-before-close ordering rule is the Verified +1 policy, not the precheck mechanism, but docs incorrectly imply the precheck enforces the ordering
